title: "Watermark"

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
source(file.path("..", "..", "shots.R"))
```

Add specific text or patterns to the page.

## Basic usage

The most basic usage.

```{r basic, eval = FALSE, shot = TRUE}
el_watermark(
  content = "Element Plus",
  font = list(color = "rgba(0, 0, 0, .15)"),
  tags$div(style = "height: 500px")
)
```

## Multi-line watermark

Use `content` to set an array of strings to specify multi-line text watermark content.

Several lines: `content` is a vector.

```{r multi-line, eval = FALSE, shot = TRUE}
el_watermark(
  content = c("Element+", "Element Plus"),
  font = list(color = "rgba(0, 0, 0, .15)"),
  tags$div(style = "height: 500px")
)
```

## Image watermark

Specify the image address via `image`. To ensure that the image is high definition and not stretched, set the width and height, and upload at least twice the width and height of the logo image address.

`image` draws a picture instead of text; `watermark_width` and `height`
size it (`width` is the box's).

```{r image, eval = FALSE, shot = TRUE}
el_watermark(
  watermark_width = 130,
  height = 30,
  image = "https://element-plus.org/images/element-plus-logo.svg",
  tags$div(style = "height: 500px")
)
```

## Custom configuration

Preview the watermark effect by configuring custom parameters.

Its settings from the controls: each control's value is a store's
field, [v_model()], and the watermark's `font` and `gap` getters built
from them, [v_bind()], so it changes as they do, in the browser.

```{r custom, eval = FALSE, shot = TRUE}
vue_store(
  "wm",
  state = list(
    content = "Element Plus",
    color = "rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.15)",
    size = 16,
    rotate = -22,
    gap = 100
  ),
  getters = list(
    font = JS("function(s) { return { fontSize: s.size, color: s.color }; }"),
    gaps = JS("function(s) { return [s.gap, s.gap]; }")
  )
)
el_row(
  el_col(
    span = 14,
    el_watermark(
      content = v_bind("$vueStore.wm.content"),
      rotate = v_bind("$vueStore.wm.rotate"),
      gap = v_bind("$vueStore.wm.gaps"),
      font = v_bind("$vueStore.wm.font"),
      tags$div(
        style = "padding: 40px 20px; height: 360px",
        tags$h1("Element Plus"),
        tags$h2("A Vue 3 based component library for designers and developers")
      )
    )
  ),
  el_col(
    span = 10,
    el_input(
      "content",
      label = "Content",
      value = v_model("$vueStore.wm.content")
    ),
    el_color_picker(
      "color",
      label = "Color",
      value = v_model("$vueStore.wm.color"),
      show_alpha = TRUE
    ),
    el_slider(
      "size",
      label = "FontSize",
      value = v_model("$vueStore.wm.size"),
      min = 8,
      max = 40
    ),
    el_slider(
      "rotate",
      label = "Rotate",
      value = v_model("$vueStore.wm.rotate"),
      min = -180,
      max = 180
    ),
    el_input_number("gap", label = "Gap", value = v_model("$vueStore.wm.gap"))
  )
)
```
